name: Hibana
source:
A girl who wants [url=/c145784]Tsumi[/url] to keep his eyes only on her. She's always energetic and regards herself as the cutest, so she gets jealous when Tsumi interacts with the other girls, to the point where she often causes mischief by awkwardly butting into their conversations.

[From [url=https://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/lipm/character.html]official website[/url]]
